## Phase 1 PLAN
New package `evidence/` (sig-evidence). Modules:
- digest.py  multihash base32-lower (sha2-256=0x12, sha2-512=0x13) + blake3 fixity (EVID-002/003/004) [stdlib+blake3]
- ocfl.py    OCFL 1.1 writer/reader; inventory.json (sha512 manifest) + fixity (blake3); ocfl_layout.json; namaste; readable w/o SIG code (EVID-005) [stdlib]
- storage.py ObjectStore protocol; LocalFileStore (tests); S3ObjectStore boto3 w/ versioning+Object Lock GOVERNANCE + default retention (EVID-006) [boto3 lazy]
- tiers.py   StorageTier enum; sealed metadata-only public representation (EVID-009/010)
- capture.py CaptureSet (WACZ+screenshot+payload+raw HTML -> 1 artifact/N captures, EVID-008); WARC->WACZ 1.1.1 packaging stdlib zipfile (EVID-007); live Playwright capture (gated) [playwright lazy]
- redaction.py redaction=new capture w/ parent_capture_id (EVID-011)
- disappearance.py disappearance event + research_task gen + link-rot sweep + Wayback (EVID-013/014/015)
- ingest_run.py deterministic env (LC_ALL=C/TZ=UTC EVID-018) + reproducibility helper (EVID-016/017)
- store.py EvidenceStore facade; cli.py/__main__.py CLI

DB (new sqitch change `evidence_store`):
- evidence_blob(blob_digest PK, source_uri NOT NULL, ...) UNIQUE(blob_digest,source_uri) -> dedup, EVID-004 (one blob, N capture rows)
- alter evidence_capture: drop UNIQUE(content_digest,artifact_id) [blocks N rows]; add blob_digest FK; add source_uri
- evidence_access_log (EVID-012) requester/purpose/ts + retention; grants+RLS
- verify/revert; update sqitch.plan

Docs: ADR-023 (evidence pkg layout deviation + dedup/blob model + capture uniqueness relax); update traceability.md, risk_register.md; evidence/README.md.
Deps: blake3, boto3, playwright (+dev moto). uv lock + export.
Deviations to record: new pkg (layout); relax evidence_capture uniqueness -> evidence_blob dedup model.
